inspectionMethod.mode: full-range machine listening plus stereo side-channel inspection

audioInputs.description: 16 kHz mono source decode for full-mix AudioSet classification
FL-FR stereo side residual, loudness normalized only for detecting quiet non-speech bed under centered narration
unaltered PCM stereo decode used for mid/side RMS measurements
complete 29-second loudness-normalized review copy; no time edits

inspectionMethod.decisionRule: Music/atmosphere is marked constant when either the full mix or low-level stereo side residual repeatedly classifies as Music across adjacent windows and the side channel has no full-window silence. A UI-action sound is marked absent only within the decoded source scope when no click, mouse, keyboard, copy, paste or menu-confirmation event is detected in the action window; this does not assert universal nonexistence outside the source.

stageDecisions.observation: Low-level music/atmospheric bed is present under centered speech; no step-related UI sound opportunity occurs.
The low-level bed continues through the WPS failure display. No audible event independently establishes a copy or paste action that created the shown failure.
Music/atmosphere remains under narration across answer and prompt frames. No keyboard or typing evidence independently establishes prompt entry.
The bed continues. No discrete click/tap or completion tone independently proves the send click, generation completion, or Run HTML action.

stageDecisions.videoStage: blank document, preview selection and WPS menu
stageDecisions.observation: The bed continues through the edited transfer sequence. No discrete mouse, copy, paste or menu-confirmation sound independently proves the missing bridge actions.
The low-level bed continues and ends with a brighter ding-like musical accent in the final two seconds. The accent aligns with the closing beat, not with a visible send/copy/paste action.

fullScopeDecision.role: low-level pacing/atmospheric bed under narration, with a brighter closing accent
fullScopeDecision.stepEvidence: No decoded non-speech event independently proves sending, running HTML, copying, switching applications, pasting, or menu confirmation.
limitations: AudioSet labels and scores are machine-listening proposals, not exact source identification.
Centered narration can mask quiet mono-compatible background elements; stereo side inspection reduces but does not eliminate this limitation.
The absence finding is bounded to the decoded 0–29.067-second source and the named action windows.
